To sign electronically a Word document with your identity card, you can follow these general steps:

1. Open your Word document and click on the "Sign" button in the "Protect" section of the ribbon.
2. Select "Add Signature" and choose the type of signature you want to add (e.g., digital ID, certificate, or image).
3. If you have a digital ID or certificate, select it from the list of available identities.
4. If you don't have a digital ID or certificate, you can upload an image of your identity card by clicking on "Image" and selecting the file from your computer.
5. Once you've added your signature, click on "OK" to save the changes.

Please note that these steps are general and may vary depending on your specific situation and software version.
